text:
Ava L: quick sync — customers are confused by the 'KMS' chip in the region picker. they interpret it as 'keys move with the project'.
Tom R: yep, we need clearer language: KMS status is about accessibility in the target region, not portability. current copy is too terse.
Sofia P: suggestion: in the picker show small label 'KMS: customer (not usable in target region)' and on click open a short modal explaining options. avoid the word 'portable' — it's ambiguous.
Ken M: UX constraint: long labels break header on small screens. keep the chip short: 'KMS: customer' + tooltip with full sentence and a link to docs. tooltip must be keyboard accessible.
Ava L: accessibility note — tooltips need focusable anchors and aria-describedby. modal should use role="dialog" and set initial focus to title. also announce post-move banners with aria-live="polite".
Sofia P: modal copy draft (short + expanded): short: 'Relocating project region may change retention and which encryption keys are usable.' expanded bullets: 'Retention may fall back to the target region default', 'Customer-managed keys are region-bound; you will need to add a new key in the target region or use platform-managed encryption', 'Audit trail will record the relocation with tag "region-move".'
Tom R: CTA discussion: options — primary: 'Relocate project', secondary: 'Relocate and add key now', danger: 'Cancel'. Concern: 'Relocate and add key now' implies we start an upload flow immediately; do we want that?
Ken M: engineering prefers non-blocking moves. propose primary 'Relocate project' and then show a persistent in-app banner after move: 'Customer key not available in <region>. Add key' + secondary 'Remind me later'. Banner should include an icon and not rely on color alone.
Ava L: audit log format request for SRE/security: UI-friendly: 'Ava L relocated project phoenix from us-east1 to ap-southeast1; retention defaulted to 90 days; customer KMS unavailable.' machine-friendly: 'event=region_move actor=Ava_L from=us-east1 to=ap-southeast1 retention=defaulted_90d kms=unavailable tag=region-move'
Sofia P: contrast nit: the post-move banner currently uses pale yellow bg. fails WCAG AA on 12/14px text. options: darker amber #B36B00 or keep pale bg + 2px solid amber border + icon. include hex and AA pass/fail in ticket.
Tom R: keyboard behavior: when modal includes a 'I understand...' checkbox, Esc should not close it. If no checkbox, Esc can close. tab order must be logical and screen reader friendly.
Ken M: dev acceptance criteria: include short + expanded copy, sample audit log strings (UI + machine), color swatches with contrast calc, ARIA attributes for tooltip/banner/modal, mobile truncation rules for KMS chip, and the post-move banner mock.
Deploy Bot: preview pushed to staging at 1865123600 — https://staging.redwood.cloud/preview/1865123600
Ava L: thanks everyone — I'll file the ticket with mocks and a11y checklist and tag @Ken M for engineering estimate. :white_check_mark:
